messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in Part 3 and meta with Movisens Files
parts:
Sorry Steph, I merged that test branch into the GGIR master branch, you can now install the latest version, with those updates included, via:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

Can you please try again and let me know if the other errors disappear as a result of this?

The temperature warning "temperature is too high" is interesting. Let me know if you keep getting this and/or if the temperature values look suspicious. 

Kind regards,

Vincent
